experiment: S3 action sensitivity + S6 EMA control (stab0917_b)

protocol.s1step: ||F(z,a1)-F(z,a2)|| / ||(a1-a2)/act_std||, one-step predict head (differing action at the z_{t+1}-driving context position)
protocol.persistence: impulse = a1/a2 only at the z_{t+1}-driving action then shared dataset actions; sustained = center+-d at every step; ||dz_h|| raw, /h1, /||z_base_h||
protocol.response_matching: last-frame obs += 0.1*per-dim obs std; response of EMA'd one-step predicted latent, alpha grid; primary variant anchors EMA at the shared pre-perturbation context latent (resp analytic in alpha); perturbed-anchor variant kept as encoder-pathway diagnostic; alpha* matches trace@1.0, alpha_required = ratio

closed_loop.hook: cem_predict_hook EMA on last predicted position; anchor = planner-buffer last entry
